_meta._note: All scores from Hicks et al. HealthBench Professional technical report (Apr 22 2026). Underlying model = GPT-5.4 (NOT GPT-5.5; the Apr 22 PDF §3 explicitly names 'GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.2 Instant' as the models used in CFC). Strict-attribution rule applied: every score below has a quoted excerpt confirming model+benchmark+value.
